verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting and serverless platform, so instance boot time and autoscaling are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence only shows serverless functions exist and that deploys reach a CDN 'in seconds'. Nothing documents sub-second instance boot or scaling to tens of thousands of instances under load. The 'scale to millions of users' line comes from a third-party Clerk template, not a Netlify compute capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load
